[EXPERIMENTAL] Set up cloud provider OIDC integrations

## Synopsis

[EXPERIMENTAL] Set up cloud provider OIDC integrations

Creates the identity resources a cloud provider needs in order to trust Pulumi
Cloud as an OIDC identity provider, so that environments can obtain short-lived
credentials without any long-lived secrets.


```
pulumi env setup [flags]
```
